column1: # Isaac can buy bread for Altin.

column3:
Please, warriors. The rain
spoiled our grain and
twelve families are hungry.{page_break}Could you spare 250 coins
for bread?{end_now}
Bless you. We will not\nforget this.{end_wait}
I understand. Everyone is\nhungry. Everyone is\nafraid.{end_wait}
The children are eating\nbecause of you. Go well.{end_wait}
You have no coins to\nspare? Neither do we.\nGo well, warrior.{end_wait}
It is not much. Tell\nthem to eat.{end_wait}
